usage: 綠色 can be used as a noun to refer to the color green.
綠色 can also act as an adjective describing something that has the color green.
When used as an adjective, 綠色 usually comes before the noun it describes, for example, 綠色衫 (green shirt).
綠色 can be combined with other words to make phrases about style or nature, like 綠色波鞋 (green sneakers).
